title: Open-Source Stock Research & Institutional Activity Tracker
author: Ok_Reply_3383
selftext:
I’ve been trying to clean up my US stock research process because I somehow always end up with 10 tabs open.  
Insider trades on one site. Congressional trades somewhere else. Institutional activity on another. Then another tool for signals, notes, etc.  
Came across this recently:  
https://openbit.trade/community  
It basically brings a lot of that into one place — institutional activity, insider/congressional trades, research, market signals and thesis tracking.  
The interesting part is that a lot of this kind of tooling is usually paid, but much of this has been built open source for the community.  
Still exploring it, but if you’re into following smart money or doing deeper stock research without stacking subscriptions, might be useful.
